detail: Disproven. Even the top of the range sits below the success number.
action: Stop it and put the budget into the webinar program.
reason: The lift is -16.8%, with a range of -28.8% to -2.8%. The success number was +28.3%.
rule: Day 30 scales when the whole range is above zero and the lift is at least +28.3%. It kills when the top of the range is under +28.3%. Anything else extends.
compare: The verdict compares the test period with the 12 weeks before, as a lift. No control group rules out other changes.
